# Allow GoogleBot related UAs to access. There are potential CORS issues related to disallowing them.
# See: https://support.google.com/manufacturers/answer/7349854?hl=en
User-agent: Googlebot
Disallow:

User-agent: AdsBot-Google
Disallow:

User-agent: Googlebot-Image
Disallow:

# Rastreadores de preview de link (WhatsApp, Facebook, Telegram, Twitter) leem
# /v4/redirect/{hash} para montar o card das mensagens enviadas aos grupos. Esta
# API e Disallow por padrao, e o preview e a unica coisa aqui feita para ser lida
# por rastreador. Sem esta excecao, a pagina de Open Graph existe mas ninguem a
# busca, e o card sai com as tags do destino final.
#
# A rota nao expoe conteudo indexavel: ela responde HTML so a rastreador de
# preview, e a pagina tem noindex,nofollow.
User-Agent: *
Allow: /v4/redirect/
Disallow: /
